title: Shantae - Dribble Fountain & Cackle Mound Labyrinths
description:
This song plays during the first and third dungeons of Shantae for the Game Boy Color. Would suit a pyramid, desert temple, etc.

This song was part of Wyatt's music pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
